description.fun: Jangmo-o is a humble little dragon with a warrior's pride: it fights with the scale on its forehead as both sword and shield, so it never turns its back on a foe. Its scales are made of hardened fur and clang like metal, and a group uses the sound to talk, show feelings and scare off rivals, which makes them famously noisy. It was the very first Pokémon designed for Generation VII.
description.guide: Jangmo-o is a Dragon-type Pokémon from Alola, based on an ankylosaur. It trains hard in remote places and clangs its scales together to communicate. It evolves into Hakamo-o at level 35 and then into Kommo-o at level 45.
description.tagline: A pint-sized dragon warrior that never turns its back

description.fun: Hakamo-o leaves its group to train alone, roaming wherever it can find a fight. Before battle it performs a fierce dance, clanging its scales and ending with a war cry, a ritual that seems to nod to the Polynesian haka, then attacks all-out, trusting its scales as armour. It wears its broken scales proudly as proof of a good fight, and since they conduct heat well, shed ones are made into pots and pans.
description.guide: Hakamo-o is a Dragon- and Fighting-type Pokémon that evolves from Jangmo-o. It travels alone seeking opponents and challenges them with a dance and a war cry, possibly inspired by the haka. It evolves into Kommo-o at level 45.
description.tagline: A scrappy young dragon that dances and roars before every fight

description.fun: After its harsh training, Kommo-o returns home to watch over young Jangmo-o from a distance. Its scales are as hard as steel, and people once made them into armour and weapons; it clangs them to scare off weak opponents it doesn't want to fight. Legend says its glittering scales are meant to drive away a great darkness, and that's why it seeks out strong foes.
description.guide: Kommo-o is a Dragon- and Fighting-type Pokémon and the final form of Jangmo-o. Its steel-hard scales serve as armour and can produce sound waves, and it is the only Pokémon that learns Clanging Scales. In Alola, a Totem Kommo-o guards the trial in Vast Poni Canyon.
description.tagline: A dragon in clanging armour, training to drive away the darkness
